truth: CORE-01, CORE-03 and CORE-04 are closed as construction dependencies. CORE-02 remains preserved incomplete with Success Memory outstanding.

PLATFORM-00A Platform Environment + Application Roots is implemented on mergeable draft PR #29 at head 73c350b7c9b93b7617b4f36ac1fa9d1e92f34729. PLATFORM-00 remains preserved incomplete; hosted exact-head execution remains UNOBSERVED.
Global reselection chose DAW-00A because every later workspace adapter needs one host-neutral runtime identity before any named DAW can accidentally become N0TE product priority.
DAW-00A is the only active increment. Ableton Live, FL Studio, Logic Pro, Pro Tools, Studio One and REAPER are peer core host families; GENERIC_OTHER is explicit long-tail identity.
Host identity is descriptive context only. It contains no default/preferred/rank/capability/support/adapter-maturity/path/process semantics and cannot grant execution authority.

Host runtime fingerprint binds canonical host family, version, edition, PLATFORM-00A OS/architecture identity and translation mode. Raw OS/machine alias spelling and platform support tier are excluded.
Core-host display labels are cosmetic and excluded from fingerprint identity. GENERIC_OTHER requires an explicit normalized host label so unrelated unknown DAWs are never collapsed into one identity.
Unknown host labels fail visibly unless the caller deliberately represents them as GENERIC_OTHER. Detection never silently manufactures support truth.
The DAW-00A host-identity semantic matrix passed 15/15 focused local tests before publication. Repository regressions are authored; hosted exact-head execution has not yet been observed.
No named DAW adapter, host feature registry, process discovery, project-file identity, FocusContext, Host Shadow, plugin hosting, DAW mutation or UI implementation is included in DAW-00A.
PLATFORM-00 and CORE-02 remain preserved for later global reselection. Historical Ableton maturity provides zero scheduling priority.
Direct legacy source/test-text copying remains blocked by LICENSE-GATE-001.
